comments.text: This component allows you to send a request to Xano using the Xano JS SDK.
Setting up the different request types supported by the SDK

Setup XanoClient. This is the SDK we are using to interface with Xano.

The XanoClient is created and stored in a Noodl Variable called "xano". This allows it to be accessible globally through:

Noodl.Variables.xano
This component needs to be placed in your Root Component to work properly.
Check if a Xano auth token has been set
/auth/me to check if session is valid
Update this if you authenticate with other parameters than Email and Password
Send an Event just in case we want to react to the Login somewhere in the app that is not connected to the Component Outputs
Setting the token to null clears the token
Log out a logged in user
Send an Event just in case we want to react to the Logout somewhere in the app that is not connected to the Component Outputs

parameters.functionScript:
Outputs.Data = {
    'email': Inputs.Email,
    'password': Inputs.Password,
    'firstName': Inputs.firstName,
    'lastName': Inputs.lastName
}

Outputs.Done()
